name: Slinn Voda, the Rising Deep
oracle_text:
Kicker {1}{U} (You may pay an additional {1}{U} as you cast this spell.)
When Slinn Voda enters, if it was kicked, return all creatures to their owners' hands except for Merfolk, Krakens, Leviathans, Octopuses, and Serpents.
blocked_sentences: When Slinn Voda enters, if it was kicked, return all creatures to their owners' hands except for Merfolk, Krakens, Leviathans, Octopuses, and Serpents.

needs.what: The kicked flag has to survive the cast-to-battlefield zone change and reach a triggered ability, so a `self_enters` trigger whose intervening-if is `{"kicked": true}` is true exactly when the kicker cost was paid. Concretely, the same three-step plumbing that already exists for X: record it on the object as it resolves (`GameObject.cast_x` at objects.py:77, set at stack.py:193 by `obj.cast_x = item.x`), carry it into the trigger's bindings (triggers.py:380 already does `"x": obj.cast_x`), and set it on the ability's EffectContext (stack.py:250 `_resolve_ability`, mirroring the `kicked=item.kicked` that stack.py:185 `_resolve_spell` already passes). This is the whole of what this card needs -- every other piece is already shipped, including the `kicker` cost field, the `{"kicked": true}` condition, the `self_enters` trigger event and the `not_subtypes` selector key the bounce half wants.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `{"kicked": true}` is the right condition and the loader will happily accept it here -- `_mentions_kicked` (loader.py:278-281) walks each ability's effects and its trigger condition, so the card passes the half-a-kicker check and loads clean. It is then silently inert: `stack._resolve_ability` builds its EffectContext without a `kicked=` argument, so `EffectContext.kicked` (context.py:37) falls back to its `False` default and `conditions.evaluate`'s `ctx.kicked == bool(cond["kicked"])` (conditions.py:62-63) is false on every resolution, kicked or not. The bounce would never happen, which is exactly the quietly-wrong card a gap record exists to prevent -- and gate verification, which casts a kicker card *kicked* (verify.py:498), would see an unchanged board. Putting the effect in `spell_effects`, where `kicked` genuinely works, is not open: Slinn Voda is a permanent and the loader routes a permanent's effects to `abilities`. Nothing else records how a permanent was cast either -- `StackItem.kicked` is documented as decided at cast time and read on resolution "because that is the only place it can be known: nothing about the object afterwards records what was paid for it" (structs.py:99-102), `zone_is` reads the source's current zone, and `cast_x` is the only cast-time value carried across the zone change. The bounce clause on its own is fully expressible -- `return_to_hand` over `{"zone": "battlefield", "types": ["Creature"], "not_subtypes": ["Merfolk", "Kraken", "Leviathan", "Octopus", "Serpent"], "count": "all"}`, the same shape already shipped on Whelming Wave -- but ungated it would fire on the unkicked {6}{U}{U} mode too, which is a strictly different card.
